narrative.northStar: Native developer tools — Xcode and Instruments
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: Native developer tools — Xcode and Instruments.**

The application is a compact egui desktop workbench. Parser and Cookbooks have equal standing in a persistent navigation rail. System typography, neutral light and dark surfaces, and resizable working panes keep source material, results, and inspection evidence close together.

The visual character is restrained and practical, with a clear hierarchy from workspace to run to selected document and evidence. Distinct inset surfaces, readable text, compact controls, and diagnostic color organize the work. Advanced actions live in contextual menus; inspectors and disclosure sections reveal supporting evidence.

**Key Characteristics:**

- Dense native controls and system typography.
- Neutral surfaces with semantic color.
- Resizable panes and context-preserving selection.
- Explicit source-loading and extraction actions.
keyCharacteristics: Dense native controls and system typography.

rules.name: Native units
rules.body: All dimensions use egui logical points. No HTML/CSS component previews are provided because the implementation is native egui.

rules.name: Comparison split
rules.body: Source defaults to 45% of local comparison width, resizes within 30–65%, and retains its fraction as available width changes. Below 650 egui points, source/result tabs replace the split.

rules.name: Focused inspection
rules.body: With an ingredient selected, available content width below 760 or height below 480 egui points replaces document content with the inspector. Back to review and the selected document title retain context; both Back to review and the inspector close control return to the same document.

rules.name: Compact comparison headings
rules.body: Below 650 egui points, source/result tabs replace columns and repeated pane headings are suppressed. An extracted title matching the selected document title is suppressed; distinct titles remain visible.

rules.name: Source-first table widths
rules.body: Parser Input initially receives 30% of available table width and Name receives 22%; resizable columns preserve user control.

rules.name: Compact run header and review controls
rules.body: Below 760 available width or 580 remaining height in egui points, book counts move to title hover text and the header gap becomes 4 rather than 16 points. Below 650 comparison width, Review note is an inline menu beside review controls rather than a separate collapsing row.

dos: Do preserve the equal standing of Parser and Cookbooks.
Do use the shared theme and existing egui controls for new surfaces.
Do keep local-width pane transitions and independent scrolling intact.
Do keep selected source, computed result, and evidence visibly connected.
donts: Don't introduce web landing-page typography or decorative dashboard cards into the native workbench.
Don't use semantic diagnostic colors as unrelated decoration.
Don't make opening a source or restoring a session initiate extraction.
